title: Toem 2: A Cozy Photo Adventure Where You Fix Pipes and Make Friends
summary: What if your camera could also be a screwdriver? In Toem 2, that's exactly what happens! This cozy game is all about wandering through a cute black-and-white world, taking pictures, and helping the funny characters you meet. I got to play a little bit of it, and it felt like a tiny, happy vacation. You start in a riverside town called Deltburg, where a plumber named Plum needs your help. There's a giant clog in a pipe — yuck! — and water is spraying everywhere. Plum gives you a screwdriver that attaches to your camera (don't ask why, just go with it), and you twist valves to fix the mess. Plum becomes your 'Friend' who gives you new tools to explore. The best part? The quests don't feel like chores. You just wander around and stumble into things. At the aquarium, I unblocked a pipe to feed fish through a funny food dispenser. I met a robot comedian who forgot what bikes look like, and a sleepy guy on a roof who needed coffee. There's even a scent-maker who smells gross things through your photos! You can also just photograph singing fish or a charming snake in the river. Your journal tracks your progress, but I didn't care about finishing fast. I just wanted to take pictures of everything because it was so delightful. Toem 2 is planned to launch later in 2026 for Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, and PC. If you like exploring, solving gentle puzzles, and wearing silly hats, this might be your new favorite game.
why_it_matters: Small acts of helping, like fixing a pipe, can turn strangers into friends—just like being helpful in your classroom or neighborhood can lead to fun adventures.

background_read: The first 'Toem' game, released in 2021, was a black-and-white adventure where you helped characters by taking pictures.
It was made by a small Swedish studio called Something We Made and won awards for its cozy, gentle style.
Many cozy games like 'Animal Crossing' and 'Unpacking' focus on relaxing exploration instead of action.
Article_Structure: WHO: A young explorer with a camera-screwdriver tool, Plum the plumber, and many funny characters.
WHAT: Fixing a giant clog in a pipe, taking photographs, and helping quirky friends like a robot comedian.
WHERE: In the cozy riverside town of Deltburg, including places like an aquarium and rooftops.
WHY: To help new friends, explore a charming world, and fill your photo journal with delightful discoveries.

perspectives.description: Players who enjoy slow, creative games will love wandering around and taking photos with no hurry or pressure.
Gamers who want fast fights or super-tough brainteasers might find the quests too simple and wish for more challenge.
